summary: Floor 41 has an existing manifest at floors/floor_41_oanda_trading_floor/floor_manifest.json and a working OANDA practice integration (oanda_trading_floor.py, oanda_paper_strategy_lab.py, floor41_paper_ledger.py). Practice credentials are configured in .env.oanda_practice. The existing implementation produces oanda_trading_floor_status, latest_snapshot, paper_strategy_latest, paper_ledger. What is missing is the dashboard interior (rooms/workers visible when floor=41 selected), a complete trade lifecycle with reason+risk+Guardian gates, worker thoughts, OpenClaw Floor 41 findings, and the qsb_floor41_oanda_* registry family that the new V1 frontend layer expects.

questions.does_floor_41_have_workers: Yes — V1 canonical has 8 workers home_floor=41 (paper_strategy_analyst, market_scout, momentum_scout, breakout_watcher, spread_watcher, spread_gatekeeper, openclaw_market_probe, wrk_trading_floor_visual_reporter) + sandbox seeds.
questions.does_floor_41_have_live_paper_data: Yes — oanda_trading_floor_latest_snapshot.json holds account_summary + pricing. status_ts: 2026-06-08T21:13:58.941150+00:00 (stale ~16h at audit time).
questions.does_floor_41_have_open_trade_data: Partial — /api/trading/oanda/open_trades exists and oanda_open_trades_practice fetches from the API. No qsb_floor41 lifecycle store yet.
questions.does_floor_41_have_closed_trade_data: Partial — floor41_paper_ledger.json holds 503 entries but only the paper-strategy lab format. No dedicated closed_trades registry.
questions.does_floor_41_have_pnl_data: Implicit — derivable from the ledger entries but no consolidated qsb_floor41_oanda_pnl.json exists.
questions.does_floor_41_have_tick_price_data: Yes — oanda_trading_floor_latest_snapshot.json.pricing carries bid/ask, and tower_ops.oanda_practice_pricing exposes live prices.
questions.does_floor_41_have_dashboard_interior_da: No — the qsb_3d_workers floor inspector currently has 8 workers in 4 rooms after this morning's render-visible phase, but no OANDA-specific cards, tables, boards or trade panels.
questions.does_floor_41_support_opening_closing_pr: Yes at the OANDA API level (paper_trading_enabled=true, practice base URL) — but NOT yet wired to a Floor 41 dashboard panel with reason+risk+Guardian gates.
